design: Informative paired contrasts, not a Cartesian product. Seeds are shared across bands. Deterministic repeated seeds are reproducibility checks, not independent physical designs.
commonControls: same identity and all unvaried attributes
same body, foot, fitness, initial geometry and intended action
same seed, opposition and canonical engine
no future physical RNG draws in perception or policy

experiments.hypothesis: Familiarity changes recognition and coordination before it changes physical opportunity
experiments.conditions: counter support, playmaker preparation, pressed teammate; natural versus unfamiliar role; strict/tinkering/trusting demands
experiments.metric: recognition timestamps, integrated movement, actual canonical pass outcome
experiments.falsifier: familiarity grants a physical execution bonus or motion before recognition

experiments.hypothesis: Correct recognition can precede physical readiness or arrive after control is lost
experiments.expectedAttribute: familiarity and existing perception latency; response-mode intervention
experiments.conditions: motor/prepared/deliberate, 0.1/0.9 familiarity, 0.1/1.2 seconds preparation, quiet/closing opponent
experiments.metric: observation, recognition, intention, preparation margin, real shot release, cancellation, physical outcome
experiments.negativeControl: quiet opponent with the same body preparation
experiments.falsifier: shot releases before preparation/contact or without ball control

experiments.hypothesis: Adaptability affects acquisition from relevant exposure, independently of coach demands
experiments.expectedAttribute: hidden adaptability and professionalism for training only
experiments.conditions: three coach policies and three adaptability bands, explicit compatible revisions
experiments.metric: typed knowledge progression; explicitly not canonical football performance
experiments.falsifier: time alone grants knowledge, or one revision erases unrelated knowledge

experiments.hypothesis: Bounded advice can alter a recipient's reaction without sharing hidden profiles
experiments.expectedAttribute: leadership affects trust; gameReading affects confidence, with insight content injected experimentally
experiments.metric: acceptance, recognition, actual movement and canonical pass result
experiments.falsifier: unseen sender is accepted, expired evidence works, or teammate skill is multiplied

experiments.hypothesis: Pressure, fatigue, context and explicit personal incentives permit bounded near-tie discretion
experiments.expectedAttribute: composure in interpretation; no ambition-to-shot mapping
experiments.conditions: neutral/protecting/chasing, fresh/exhausted, team-first/personal incentive, three coach policies
confounds: injected candidate values and risk interpretations
experiments.metric: selection, instruction compliance and regret; execution/outcome remain null
experiments.negativeControl: unobserved/infeasible or clearly inferior personal option
experiments.falsifier: personal incentives override the fixed regret bound or invent outcomes

experiments.hypothesis: Heading affects intentional placement separately from aerial reach
experiments.conditions: moving ball at two speeds, oblique approach, pressure, unreachable height
confounds: heading also affects contact execution profile
experiments.metric: real reach/contact time, launched velocity, integrated target-plane error and on-target result
experiments.negativeControl: vary aggression with identical header; ball beyond reach
experiments.falsifier: heading changes geometric reach or no placement difference appears across relevant contexts

experiments.hypothesis: Composure answers relevant pressure demand rather than improving every quiet shot
experiments.conditions: identical placed strike with side marker versus no marker
confounds: marker supplies both pressure and geometry; held identical within each band comparison
experiments.metric: integrated target-plane error and on-target result
experiments.falsifier: quiet-shot result changes or pressured paired errors show no response

experiments.hypothesis: Keeper approach/reaction differences can matter in a real closing encounter
experiments.conditions: four intended release times (0/0.15/0.6/1.2 seconds), placed/chip, mirrored lateral targets
experiments.metric: real keeper motion, scheduled versus actual release, physical save/goal or failure
experiments.negativeControl: missed release is censored as attribute outcome evidence, not counted as a successful intended shot
experiments.falsifier: outcomes remain flat in informative windows; retain inconclusive result

experiments.hypothesis: Leaving goal should be distinguishable from unreachable or defender-first choices
experiments.conditions: three actual through-ball target depths and attacker-keeper races
confounds: canonical claim forecast uses current exact ball geometry
decision boundary may not be crossed by the chosen bands
experiments.metric: meaningful-choice diagnostic plus actual keeper movement, ownership and downstream result
experiments.falsifier: meaningful races yield no band separation; no inactive-attribute claim
experiments.staged: inaccurate/stale player-local keeper reads require a perception adapter; not fabricated in this PR

experiments.hypothesis: Contact quality, turning/recovery and progression against an opponent are distinct capabilities
experiments.conditions: spin reception, body-only turn, two-contact feint against committing/delaying opponent
confounds: multiple attributes already contribute to shared foot contact
experiments.metric: physical first contact, later recovery, turn time, actual contacts and escape
experiments.negativeControl: dribbling in a body-only turn; same defender/seed for technique and dribbling contrasts
experiments.falsifier: only a directly calculated quality score changes, with no physical consequence

experiments.hypothesis: Set-piece ability affects actual specialised free-kick launch and placement
confounds: spin changes with the existing specialisation
experiments.metric: canonical free-kick release and integrated plane error
experiments.negativeControl: ordinary foot shot/heading do not use a free-kick profile
experiments.falsifier: only declared ability changes while physical launch and flight remain identical

experiments.hypothesis: Existing responsibilities must be inventoried before assigning new causal roles
experiments.conditions: source inventory, bounded recognition/communication/motivation/learning prototypes, existing career and challenge mechanisms
confounds: career effects differ from canonical match effects
experiments.metric: concrete source reads and conditional prototype traces; no universal attribute validation
experiments.negativeControl: no production schema or coefficient changes
experiments.falsifier: a new experimental read is presented as pre-existing live match evidence
